segments.text: Ok so this is the Components and surfaces page for OpenAI Agents with Vue, and I'm reporting a problem on this page.
This is the problem, umm, the Vue server code calls the TanStack chat function without a thread ID, and the current package needs one.
This is my project, I've implemented the exact code from the doc.
Moving on to the demo. I asked for the plans table, it should render a table in the chat, but nothing comes back, the run fails with a chat needs a thread ID error.
So basically, the page's own Vue server breaks on every run with today's install, and uh, there's no OpenAI Agents agent on the page either.
So this needs a fix, kindly check it.
